## Checks

- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --all-features` pass
- [ ] A test covers the change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] For a change to how ROOT files are read or written: checked against ROOT C++ or uproot
